四、被背叛了，我怎麼重新做決定？: 4. I was betrayed. How do I make decisions again?

是不是自己太忙、太獨立，或太依賴對方？: Was I too busy, too independent, or too dependent on them?

也可以暫時什麼都不決定。: You can also decide nothing for now.
不用急著原諒。: There is no need to rush to forgive.
不用急著證明自己很堅強。: There is no need to rush to prove you are strong.
更不用為了讓對方後悔，逼自己立刻變得更好。: And you certainly don't need to push yourself to become better overnight just to make them regret it.
